verdict.rationale: Tailscale exposes a CLI and supports automating the tailnet via infrastructure-as-code, webhooks, and other integrations, which could in principle be scripted to apply changes (e.g., ACL/tag updates) across many devices at once, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk API, bulk UI action, or example of operating on many items simultaneously. Missing for 10: documented bulk API endpoints or admin-console bulk actions, evidence of scaling automation across large device/user sets, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
